title: 第2704章 七位逆天之子第2703章 世界的真相
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
那无数残肢断臂背后，赫然是一块块传说中的大衍石板！
咕噜！
元灵不灭城城主吞了一口口水，眼中震惊之色溢于言表。
他到如今才知道，这传说中的大衍石板，世间最好的大道境突破机缘，其本质竟然只是钉住那些残肢断臂的一块巨大石壁。
哗啦！
一条残肢断臂，在疯狂摇摆的时候，一滴血被甩脱出来，落在了石壁上的一角。
嗡！
一瞬间，沾染了那一滴血液的石板，迅速爆发出强悍的大道气息。
元灵不灭城城主心头一震。
他知道，只要那块石板坠落下来，必然会是一块顶尖的大衍石板！
这一块石板，甚至有机会直接造就一个混元大道境强者！
“竟然是这样！竟然是这样！”他喃喃自语，看向那些残肢断臂的眼神，都变得不同了。
而看着他这副惊恐的表情，下方众人却是一脸迷茫。
“他到底看到了什么？”
“不知道，不过能让一位逆天之子都震惊的事情，一定不一般！”
有人低声议论着。
不过就在这时……
呼！
空中的元灵不灭城城主，身子忽然僵在了原地。
他一脸惊恐的抬起头，看向天空，仿佛那里正在发生什么可怕的事情。

“又怎么回事？”
“不知道啊！什么也看不见，也感受不到威压或者气仙气波动！”
“大道也没有变化！天地规则也很安分！”
“他在害怕什么？”
众人越发不解了。
不过，在元灵不灭城城主眼中，事情却并非这样！
在他的视线之中，空中原本那些躁动的残肢断臂，此刻忽然停了下来，变得分外安静。
下一瞬……
呼！
所有残肢断臂，全都调转了方向，指向了元灵不灭城城主。
在这一瞬间，元灵不灭城城主只觉得汗毛倒竖。
一种难以名状的恐惧感涌上心头！
“会死！”一个念头浮现而出。
不过，就在这时……
“时机到了！”血肉之门内，那嘶哑的声音响起。
content_en:
Behind the countless stumps and broken arms are the legendary Dayan stone slabs!
Gulu!
The Lord of Yuanling Immortal City swallowed a mouthful of saliva, the shock in his eyes was beyond words.
Only now did he know that the legendary Dayan Slate, the best opportunity to break through to the Great Dao Realm in the world, was actually just a huge stone wall that nailed those stumps and broken arms.
Wow!
A broken limb was swinging wildly, and a drop of blood was thrown out and fell on a corner of the stone wall.
Buzz!
In an instant, the stone slab stained with that drop of blood quickly erupted into a powerful avenue aura.
The city lord of Yuanling Immortal City was shocked.
He knew that as long as that stone slab fell, it would definitely be a top Dayan stone slab!
This piece of stone may even have the opportunity to directly create a powerful person in the Hunyuan Dao Realm!
"It's actually like this! It's actually like this!" He murmured to himself, and his eyes changed when he looked at the broken limbs.
Looking at his frightened expression, everyone below looked confused.
"What did he see?"
"I don't know, but something that can shock a man who defies heaven must be extraordinary!"
Someone was talking in low voices.
But just then...
Phew!
The Lord of Yuanling Immortal City in the sky suddenly froze on the spot.
He raised his head and looked at the sky with a look of horror, as if something terrible was happening there.
"What's going on?"
"I don't know! I can't see anything, and I can't feel the pressure or the fluctuations of Qi Immortal Qi!"
"The avenue has not changed! The rules of heaven and earth are also very peaceful!"
"What is he afraid of?"
Everyone became more and more puzzled.
However, in the eyes of the city lord of Yuanling Immortal City, things are not like this!
In his sight, the restless broken limbs and broken arms in the air suddenly stopped and became extremely quiet.
The next moment...
Phew!
All the remaining limbs and arms turned around and pointed at the Lord of Yuanling Immortal City.
At this moment, the city lord of Yuanling Immortal City felt his hair standing on end.
An indescribable feeling of fear came to my heart!
"I will die!" A thought emerged.
However, at this moment...
"The time has come!" The hoarse voice sounded from within the Gate of Flesh.
